description: Trainee will learn about the Basic cyber security including computer network, vulnerability assessments, password managements, firewall and intrusion, cloud security, ethical hacking, social engineering, network traffic analysis, penetration testing, network monitoring tools etc. which are required to handle cyber security aspects requires in current professional world.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Familiarize with fundamentals of cyber security.
Familiarization to recent cybercrime incidents and related Laws to protect.
Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration testing.
Familiarization to different security control mechanisms.
Implement encryption techniques on sample data and analyze the results.
Set up and configure firewalls and intrusion detection systems.
Perform network traffic analysis and identify potential threats.
Simulate incident response scenarios and develop incident response plans.
